tasks.title: South Pacific History
tasks.instruction: Fill in the missing letters in the paragraph.
tasks.translation: 南太平洋的历史以多元文化和重大事件为标志。土著居民发展了具有丰富传统和社会结构的复杂社会。该地区的政治和经济格局在欧洲人殖民统治后经历了深刻变化。研究这段历史可以更好地理解文化互动及历史事件对当代南太平洋社会的持续影响。利用星辰和海浪的传统导航技术成就了非凡的航行成就，而当代运动则侧重于文化保护、语言复兴和应对气候变化对岛屿国家的影响。

layout.title: Career Fair
layout.body:
Hi Team,

Blundin University hosted a career fair yesterday. I was able to speak to several promising candidates for summer internships with our company. See their attached resumes. I'd like everyone to give me their feedback no later than Friday.

Thanks,
Ryan

options.A: He took a class at a university.
options.C: He was interviewed by a manager.

questions.analysis: 邮件写 Blundin University hosted a career fair yesterday，Ryan 去招聘会见了实习生候选人。答案是 B。

questions.stem: What does Ryan ask his team to do?

options.A: Share their opinions of some job candidates.

questions.analysis: Ryan 请大家 no later than Friday 给出 feedback，即对候选人发表意见。

tasks.title: The Dynamics of Hollywood's Golden Age
tasks.translation: 好莱坞黄金时代（1920 年代至 1960 年代）是电影史的变革期。在制片厂制度下，RKO 等大公司控制制片，以流水线方式打造亨弗莱·鲍嘉、凯瑟琳·赫本等明星。该制度保证稳定产量，却常限制导演和演员的创作自由。正是这种约束促使电影人在既定边界内寻求新的叙事方式。有声电影的出现彻底改变了叙事；默片明星必须适应，音乐剧等新类型则利用声音技术。1948 年最高法院裁决打破制片厂对影院的垄断，独立电影人获得空间。但制片厂制度的效率与造星机制至今仍影响好莱坞。
paras: Hollywood's Golden Age, from the 1920s to the 1960s, was a transformative period in cinema history. Under the studio system, major companies like RKO controlled film production, creating an efficient assembly-line process that produced stars such as Humphrey Bogart and Katharine Hepburn. While this system ensured a steady output of films, it often limited creative freedom for directors and actors tied to restrictive contracts. Yet this very constraint led to unexpected innovation as filmmakers sought new ways to tell compelling stories within set boundaries.

A pivotal change during this era was the introduction of sound, forever altering cinematic storytelling. Silent film stars had to adapt or risk obsolescence, while new genres like musicals capitalized on sound technology's possibilities. This shift pushed directors to experiment with narrative structures, often blurring the lines between genres to captivate audiences.

The decline of the studio system began with a 1948 Supreme Court ruling that dismantled studios' monopolies over theaters. This ruling opened the door for independent filmmakers, whose diverse and unconventional stories began gaining traction in theaters. However, the legacy of the studio system's efficiency and star-making machinery still influences Hollywood's operations today.

questions.stem: Which aspect of the studio system encouraged filmmakers to innovate?

options.A: The demand for more silent films
options.B: The freedom to create experimental films
options.D: The boundaries imposed by restrictive contracts

options.A: To highlight a development that led to new, creative narrative techniques
options.B: To emphasize the former popularity of silent films

options.A: It led to a temporary increase in studio profits.
options.B: It allowed independent films to be seen and become popular.
options.C: It caused studios to develop more large-scale musical productions.
options.D: It had no effect on Hollywood's operations.

questions.stem: What does the passage imply about the Hollywood film industry today?

options.A: Modern studios have completely abandoned all practices from the Golden Age period.
options.B: Contemporary films commonly use the storytelling techniques developed during the 1920s–1960s.
options.C: Independent filmmakers have entirely replaced the studio system's influence on cinema.
options.D: The assembly-line process of the studio system still impacts current Hollywood operations.
